steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application's name and package identifier in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Project-Level Gradle
steps.description: Set up the top-level build.gradle file with repository and dependency configurations.

steps.title: Configure Module-Level Gradle
steps.description: Specify the Android application module's build settings, SDK versions, and build tools in app/build.gradle.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest
steps.description: Create the AndroidManifest.xml file, declaring the application's package, activities, and permissions.

steps.title: Create Main Layout XML
steps.description: Design the user interface for the main activity using activity_main.xml, displaying a 'Hello World' message.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity
steps.description: Write the Java code for MainActivity, which inflates the layout and handles basic activity lifecycle events.

steps.title: Prepare Resources
steps.description: Ensure the necessary resource directories like drawable, layout, and values are in place for the app.

steps.title: Set up Android Studio Project
steps.description: Import the project into Android Studio, allowing the IDE to recognize the project structure.

steps.title: Sync Gradle Files
steps.description: Synchronize the project with Gradle to download dependencies and configure the build environment.

steps.title: Building Simple Java App
steps.description: Execute the Gradle build command to compile the application and generate the APK.
